services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Each week is different and offers high-quality opportunities for youth to learn about Art and Art History in a nurturing environment at the Salem Art Association (SAA). All camps take place at the Bush Barn Art Center & Annex in Salem’s Bush’s Pasture Park. All weeks and themes explore the larger relationship between art & nature, and include a diverse mix of artistic materials and processes. At SAA, our Art Camps prioritize learning a variety of art processes and materials to build self-confidence, develop practical skills, practice problem-solving, and to have fun. blurb: Right in the heart of Bush’s Pasture Park, one of Salem’s most beautiful locations, are the Bush Barn Art Center and Annex. These conjoined buildings feature four exhibition spaces, a gift gallery, and an Artist-in-Residence studio.
